header.title: Connect
header.subtitle: wire the moves back together, and name the missing ones

header.status_line: The in-text relations are coded (78 edges on MARK-16-WEB under edge_grammar_v1_2026-08-09): LINKAGE (logic) AND SHAPE (form) are both coded. SONIC (sound) is computed separately at word-level; RESONANCE (cross-tradition correspondence) has ONE worked MATCH (Mark <-> Daodejing), a definition-plus-one-example frontier, not a scaled run. One coder, one pass, engine-proposed.

what_it_is: Connect builds the relations between the moves. Decompose breaks the passage into moves; Connect wires them back together under five KINDs of edge: which move feeds the next (the spine) and how the moves inside one passage hold together (LINKAGE); which references another text (LINEAGE); which is analogous or opposed across traditions (RESONANCE); and the form and sound that carry them (SHAPE, SONIC).
why_it_matters: A move on its own is inert; the meaning lives in how the moves relate. And the edges are the scaffold a silence hangs on: you cannot name an in-text gap until you have named the moves it sits between and the edges around it. The MISSING edge is negative space made sayable, a claim with no support under it, a move with no analogy partner across texts. A coded NO-EDGE is a first-class named silence. So Connect is where comparison becomes possible and where absence becomes an object.

how_it_works.you_give_it: the moves from Decompose (an ordered, labeled list) and their nesting.
how_it_works.the_method_does: types the relations between moves under a fixed grammar, defaulting to the weakest relation and charging every upgrade an explicit warrant, and records what it could NOT connect (a NO-EDGE is a legitimate answer, not a coder failure).
how_it_works.you_get_back: a typed relation graph (a DAG, a move can have several parents) plus the named absences.

pipeline_context.note: Connect is one node in a pipeline; these are the sibling terms it references, glossed so the card stands alone.
pipeline_context.move: one small action a text makes (agent does an operation to something, with a result) - the unit Decompose produces.
pipeline_context.Decompose: the prior node: breaks the passage into moves + their nesting (what Connect reads).
pipeline_context.Situate: the parallel node: attaches context to each move (Sitz / Paradigm / Frame / Witness / Lineage).
pipeline_context.spine: the main FEED chain of moves; a bundle = a move + its nested descendants.
pipeline_context.the braid: a downstream output that lines one text's spine up against another's.
pipeline_context.the gap-finder (LACUNA): the node that names the in-text silences (gaps) that hang between the moves Connect relates.
pipeline_context.a strand: a sub-sequence of moves threaded through a spine or bundle (one line through the graph).
pipeline_context.the golden path: the primary worked-example axis - English narrative (Mark 16 WEB) - the reference case the checks run on first.
pipeline_context.checkout home / home_row: the text's canonical anchor row in the corpus (its 'checkout' home); edges join to it so a relation is always tied to a real, versioned source.

how_we_grade_it.note: the four checks the header pills report, glossed so the pills stand alone.
how_we_grade_it.Fidelity: mechanical: does every handle the card shows map to a real connect_edge column, with in-vocab values? (labels == columns).
how_we_grade_it.Cold Read: self-sufficiency: a blind reader with no project context judges whether the card explains itself.
how_we_grade_it.vs-Wild: does the coded output beat a naive LLM given only the raw text and asked to relate the moves? (scoped to the KIND being tested, e.g. LINKAGE or SHAPE).
how_we_grade_it.CRT: Clean-Room Triangulation: blind reviewers audit the grammar for MECE (mutually exclusive + collectively exhaustive) + firewall coherence, with no prior context.
how_we_grade_it.result_categories: INCOMPLETE (not run) / FAIL (run, lost) / PARTIAL (run, largely won, a named gap remains) / PASS.
how_we_grade_it.field_contract: per grammar field: closed = fixed vocabulary; multi = may hold several values; candidate = whether a new value may be proposed (the atlas-reader pattern).

the_method_clean.note: the edge grammar, definitions only (no worked values). The KIND funnel is asked first; each KIND holds subfamilies; each type carries its definition. The controlled-value contract per field says what is closed, what is multi, and where a candidate may be proposed (the atlas-reader pattern).

grammar.gloss: in-text LOGIC: how the moves inside one passage hold together (produces / holds / joins).

types.definition: A's outcome becomes B's substrate and B produces a NEW operation from it (literal output->input).
B binds a variable / slot A left EXPLICITLY open (question -> answer lives here).
A scopes over B; B is nested inside A (generic containment).
several moves jointly make one larger emergent move (N->1).
A reports B's speech/thought within the SAME text (say/tell/think/know/claim).
A then B: temporal succession, no production (the cheap DEFAULT).
A and so B: causal consequence (A brings B about; NOT output->input).
A but B: negative-polarity opposition / denied expectation.
if A then B: modal / hypothetical / unrealized.
A, no rather B: B retracts / replaces A.
B is evidence / justification for A (epistemic, not causal).
B amplifies a FINISHED claim of A without changing it.
A sets up context / vocabulary B needs (was SCAFFOLDS).
a discourse join not covered above  -  free-text + candidate (the escape hatch).

grammar.gloss: cross-text REFERENCE: what a text stands ON, what it cites / glosses (a NT passage citing Hosea). This IS Situate's Lineage.

types.definition: B explicitly quotes / alludes to A in ANOTHER text (explicit contact).
B reuses A's material without explicit citation.
A leaves a gap unresolvable within its own frame, taken up by later reception.
a later reading re-reads A (folds REINTERPRETS/FORKS; continuity is evidence-gated).
B inherits A across a tradition boundary (documented borrowing).

grammar.gloss: a claimed CORRESPONDENCE the analyst draws (BROAD kind, scope=both): convergence (MATCH = same move; ANALOGY = A:B::C:D) OR divergence (COUNTERS / INVERTS). Holds cross-text OR in-text (a text can rhyme with itself). Carries NO contact claim (a downstream verdict).

types.definition: the SAME move in two places (2-term echo: move_here ~ move_there) - the plain 'rhyme, same move different voice'. Carries the ANALOGY axes, esp. failed_dimension (WHERE the rhyme breaks).
a 4-term proportion A:B::C:D (a RELATION rhyming with a relation); each term = a move / set / spine / strand.
the move here OPPOSES / stands against the move there (opposite valence on the same domain).
the move here is the move there turned upside down (same operation + roles, reversed direction).

grammar.gloss: in-text non-linear FORM: parallelism / juxtaposition / ring / leap.

types.definition: two moves in parallel form (was 'parallels').
two things set side-by-side, gap held open, NEVER resolved (was 'juxtaposes').
an A...A ring return / chiasm (was 'circles').
a non-logical jump between moves (was 'associative-leap').

grammar.gloss: in-text SOUND (computed): rhyme / assonance / alliteration / consonance.

types.definition: terminal-phonology tie between words (sound owns 'rhyme').
shared stressed-vowel tie.
shared onset-consonant tie.
shared consonant-set tie.

edge_record.multi: one per edge; MULTIPLE edges per connection
edge_record.candidate: open (propose -> review; LINK_other is the catch-bucket)

edge_record.note: how we know the edge is there (the coherence-coercion guard: upgrades cost evidence)
'edge' = UNDERCUTS an inference, not a move

FEED.enables: A makes B possible, does not force it

LINK_CONTRAST.concedes: B survives an expectation A raised (concession, not bare contrast)

the_method_clean.firewall: non-entailment: edges of different KINDs may coexist on one pair; no edge in one KIND licenses an inference in another. RESONANCE is named broadly and holds BOTH convergence (ANALOGY) and divergence (COUNTERS/INVERTS - a tradition standing AGAINST another), so opposition is coded under RESONANCE, not elsewhere. A RESONANCE edge asserts NEITHER contact NOR independence - it is a bare structural correspondence; contact and independence are SEPARATE downstream verdicts. Coding discipline (final-CRT): (a) when a SHAPE edge does LINKAGE's work (antithetic parallelism, juxtaposition that implies a contrast), CODE BOTH - the SHAPE form AND the LINKAGE it carries (the carrier bridge), so the logic is never left uncoded; (b) a co-present LINEAGE edge (documented contact) is EVIDENCE the downstream contact-verdict weighs toward contact - the RESONANCE edge itself still claims nothing; the firewall is that no KIND's edge auto-decides another KIND's verdict (the no-auto-decide rule).

the_method_applied.note: The grammar run on Mark 16 (78 edges). The weakest relation (LINK_sequence) is the default; FEED (literal output to input) is used sparingly; the negative-polarity relations (LINK_contrast) that had no home before are in use. The WORKED EDGES below are 8 of those 78, shown with their move text (a sample, not additional).

out_of_domain.note: the same grammar re-coded out of domain (§2.14). The distribution differs by genre without being tailored: narrative Mark is sequence-led; the Daodejing is contrast-led (apophatic). Evidence the grammar differentiates, not force-fits.

from.plain: A way that can be walked or spoken is disqualified from being the abiding way.

to.plain: He denies that he is present in the tomb.

resonance_worked_example.match_strength: strong on the MOVE: both are a negation-as-redirection ('not this / not here') that opens onto something beyond the negated thing.
resonance_worked_example.failed_dimension: temporality/ontology: DDJ's negation is a PERMANENT apophatic condition (the Dao is forever beyond naming); Mark's is a SINGULAR kerygmatic EVENT (the empty tomb points to 'he is risen, go to Galilee' - a positive claim, not standing ineffability).
resonance_worked_example.note: the ONE worked example the RESONANCE frontier owes (not a scale run): a 2-term MATCH across traditions. The failed_dimension is where the rhyme BREAKS - the honest half of the comparison.

the_method_applied.the_missing_edge: The negative-space read: a move with NO edge into it is unmotivated; a claim with no LINK_support is an assertion the text never grounds; a move with no cross-text MATCH partner is a rhyme that is not there. These absences are the between-move silence the gap-finder reads. RESONANCE has ONE worked MATCH (below), not a scaled run - the missing-rhyme read stays a frontier until it is coded at breadth.

where_saved.plain: The edges save to connect_edge (one row per edge; from_moves is a LIST, so many-to-one bundling is one row), keyed on the method key MARK-16-WEB and joined to the text's checkout home (gut-8268_016_v1). Readers filter to the current grammar version's latest run (the read rule), never bare source_key. LINEAGE edges reconcile with lineage_record (Situate's Lineage view, one store).

honest_limits: LINKAGE (logic) and SHAPE (form) are coded on all three texts. SONIC (sound) is computed separately at word-level (a different granularity, not this pass); RESONANCE (cross-tradition correspondence) has ONE worked MATCH (Mark <-> Daodejing) - a definition-plus-one-example frontier, NOT a scaled run, so it earns no green pill; the worked example proves the type codes, breadth is the next pass.

The two taxonomy questions the final CRT raised are now RESOLVED (PI CLC walk, 2026-08-09): (1) simple 2-term convergence gained a home - MATCH ('same move, different voice') sits beside 4-term ANALOGY under RESONANCE:CONVERGENCE; (2) RESONANCE is now honestly labeled scope=both (in-text OR cross-text), not mis-filed as cross-text-only - a text can rhyme with itself (in-text != in-chunk), and an edge's actual scope is read off its endpoints.

Inherent within-KIND ambiguity (some shared with RST/PDTB): LINK_CAUSE vs LINK_SUPPORT ('because'), FEED vs LINK_CAUSE, and in RESONANCE COUNTERS vs INVERTS (opposite-valence-on-the-same-domain vs same-operation-roles-reversed) are genuine coder coin-flips - handled by the weakest-default + the explicit warrant field + the LINK_OTHER candidate escape hatch, not eliminated.
One coder, one model, one pass, engine-proposed, not reliability-tested. FEED is judged locally; a skip or branch relation may be under-connected.
LINEAGE is coded only when a reception target exists; the unify-with-lineage_record reconciliation is pending.
whats_next: The spine + bundling feed the braid; the gap-finder reads the edges (the edges scaffold the gaps); Situate runs alongside (its Lineage view reconciles with the LINEAGE edges). RESONANCE is the next coding frontier at breadth - one worked cross-tradition MATCH (Mark <-> Daodejing) is coded; coding it at scale is next.

leans_on: the discourse joins (LINK_) lean on Rhetorical Structure Theory / PDTB / SDRT
the ANALOGY leans on Gentner structure-mapping (systematicity) + SKOS match-grades
the firewall leans on the comparative method (cognate / borrowed / independent)
the SHAPE / SONIC carrier leans on Jakobson's projection principle (form generates meaning)
the missing-edge / unsaid leans on presupposition theory
SONIC leans on articulatory phonology (via pronouncing + panphon)

fidelity.meta_line: Fidelity PASS (2026-08-09, mechanical): every drawer label maps to a real connect_edge column; no coded edge_type is outside the single-source vocab (drift-check PASS).

cold_read.meta_line: Cold Read PASS (2026-08-09): independent blind agent, no project context, ruled the card self-sufficient (round 3). Rounds 1-2 came back PARTIAL and were fixed to convergence: round 1 caught stale terms (transmission / constellation / analogy prose) + an assumes-pipeline gap; round 2 caught an unglossed method/storage-vocab cluster. Fixes (all render-from-data): the what_it_is + foundation prose rewritten to the 5 KINDs; a pipeline_context gloss (move / Decompose / Situate / spine / braid / gap-finder / strand / golden path / checkout home); a how_we_grade_it gloss (the 4 checks + the 4 result categories + closed/multi/candidate); the SHAPE coded-vs-not-coded self-contradiction corrected. Round 3 confirmed no contradictions + no stale vocabulary in live use.

vs_wild.meta_line: Instrument-vs-wild PASS (2026-08-09, LAYER-SCOPED, FULLY RUN on 3 texts after the SHAPE pass). Naive readers on Mark-EN (31 relations) / Greek (21) / Daodejing (14) were each covered by the instrument's LINKAGE + SHAPE coding, which adds systematic edge-typing + warrant. The SHAPE relations the readers foregrounded are now coded: DDJ parallelism (M1->M2, M3->M4 - exact match), Mark + Greek rings. Genre picks its edge-KIND (narrative->LINKAGE, apophatic wisdom->SHAPE). SONIC (word-level, computed) + RESONANCE (cross-tradition frontier) are separate passes. Instance-selection varies between a single coder pass and a reader (a reliability question, not a coverage gap). Earlier meta:
vs_wild._superseded_meta: Instrument-vs-wild PARTIAL (2026-08-09, LAYER-SCOPED). A naive reader given the moves ALONE produced 31 relations on Mark 16; the instrument's LINKAGE coding covers its logical relations AND adds systematic edge-typing + warrant + the weakest-default discipline. Run out-of-domain (§2.14) on all 3 texts: MARK-EN + Greek = clean LINKAGE PASS; the Daodejing = LINKAGE PASS but the naive reader foregrounds PARALLELISM (a SHAPE relation) - the SHAPE pass is owed. The relations the LINKAGE layer did not code (Mark's M11->M20 RING; the DDJ's parallelism) are SHAPE edges, a different layer, not a LINKAGE miss - evidence the layers are real and that genre picks its edge-KIND (narrative->LINKAGE, wisdom->SHAPE). PASS for the LINKAGE layer; the full-stack awaits the SHAPE + SONIC + RESONANCE passes.
